description: This file defines an Android AccessibilityService named ClockBackService tailored to provide custom accessibility feedback for the default Clock application on Android devices. It demonstrates handling of different feedback types (spoken, audible, haptic), reacts to system broadcasts such as screen state changes and ringer mode alterations, and manages TextToSpeech and Vibrator resources to offer enhanced, context-dependent accessibility cues.

classes.name: ClockBackService
classes.description: An AccessibilityService that provides custom feedback for the Android Clock app by responding to accessibility events and system broadcasts, using TTS, vibration, and sounds to inform users about screen state, ringer modes, and clock-related activities.

methods.name: onServiceConnected
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up TextToSpeech, Vibrator, registers broadcast receivers, and configures feedback based on current ringer mode.

methods.name: onUnbind
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as TTS and broadcast receivers when the service is unbound.

methods.name: onAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Responds to accessibility events based on the current feedback mode, providing spoken, audible, or haptic feedback accordingly.

methods.name: onInterrupt
methods.description: Stops ongoing feedback such as speech, earcon, or vibration when accessibility is interrupted.

methods.name: configureForRingerMode
methods.description: Adjusts the feedback types and notifies the user via earcon based on the device's ringer mode.

methods.name: setServiceInfo
methods.description: Configures the AccessibilityService settings including event types, feedback types, timeout, and package filters.

methods.name: generateScreenOnOrOffUtternace
methods.description: Creates a string message describing the current screen state and volume percentage.

methods.name: provideScreenStateChangeFeedback
methods.description: Provides feedback (spoken, auditory, vibratory) when the screen turns on or off based on current feedback mode.

methods.name: formatUtterance
methods.description: Formats accessibility event text into a speechable utterance, simplifying leading zeros and using content description if needed.

methods.name: playEarcon
methods.description: Plays a sound (earcon) associated with a specific event or state.

methods.name: registerBroadCastReceiver
methods.description: Sets up the broadcast receiver to listen for ringer mode changes and screen state changes.
